data.title: Care level 2 decision (Pflegegrad 2)
data.summary: Your long-term care insurer (Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse) granted care level 2 from 1 February 2025 and denied the requested level 3. It will pay care allowance of €347.00 per month.
data.explanation: The care insurer accepted care level 2 (Pflegegrad 2) based on the Medical Service's assessment (38.75 weighted points), so level 3 was not granted. You get care allowance (Pflegegeld) of €347.00 monthly, paid at the end of each month, from February 2025. If you think the decision is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the care insurer; the app shows the deadline. It also counts if it reaches another domestic authority or social insurance carrier in time. Consider advice from a care counselling service.
data.tax_note: Care allowance and care level may matter for the tax return (e.g. care-related lump sums or extraordinary burdens).

items.action: If you disagree with the decision, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Pflegekasse.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final.
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
